issues.title: Increase volume of mock assets
issues.body:
There are some performance issues with large numbers of assets (it can take a second or so to make them all appear when `Select all` is selected).

Hmm, part of this issue _could_ be that we're re-downloading all of the SVG, rather than cache-ing them.

Produce a higher volume of blue and red assets, so we can investigate performance.

Try 2500 and 3000 assets

comments.body:
Ok.  The users have asked if we can support 5k assets in the wargame.

I tried generating that many, and Serge died.

We should look at the assorted parts of Serge, and see which ones cannot handle 5k .   For `<PlanningAssets>` we have a story that generates 2000 assets (`bulk`).   We should investigate where material-table is falling over.  Number editable here:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/216004305-494ec6e5-016e-407c-b5d3-b723da8ab240.png)

The issue _may_ be in how we prepare the `type/sub-type` data.  _Maybe_ we should be getting the sub-type data by collating a list of the sub-types for the rows currently present in the table.  _Maybe_ we should only bother producing `sub-type` data if the table has already been filtered.

Note: I'm currently pushing a PR that also generates high volumes of messages for the `<PlanningMessageList>` story.
Working with client data. The `MaterialTable` was the issue
